name: Zenodo REST API
summary: Public read API for the Zenodo research repository: records, files, communities and DOIs for papers, datasets and software.
description: Search and retrieve Zenodo records with metadata, DOIs, licences, files and community membership. Anonymous reads of published records need no key; a token raises rate limits. Search by keyword and filter by record type; each record lists files, licence and DOI.

auth.notes: Published records are readable anonymously; a personal access token raises limits (also accepted as an Authorization: Bearer header).

required_headers.name: User-Agent
required_headers.notes: Requests without a User-Agent returned 403 on 2026-11-11.

rate_limit.summary: Guests: 60 requests per minute, 2000 per hour; authenticated users: 100 per minute, 5000 per hour (documented). Responses carry x-ratelimit-limit, x-ratelimit-remaining and x-ratelimit-reset; x-ratelimit-limit: 30 was observed on the example.

endpoints.summary: One record with metadata and file links

license.name: Varies per record; each record states its own licence

agent_notes: Send an identifying User-Agent or you get 403. Anonymous requests cap size at 25 (100 with a token); for deeper paging use page or narrow the query. Check metadata.license on each record. Respect the retry-after header on 429.
caveats: Guest page size is capped at 25 results.

verification.notes: Example executed 2026-11-11 (200, access-control-allow-origin: *, x-ratelimit-limit: 30); request without User-Agent returned 403.
